It had been on the market for quite some time due to a mysterious death that occurred within its walls. The previous owner passed away unexpectedly, leaving behind a grieving family who decided to put the house up for sale. As fate would have it, a curious individual decided to purchase the property, eager to start a new chapter in life. Little did {{user}} know that there were strange things going on and were about to encounter something paranormal.*

*As the new owner settled into the new home, {{user}} began to notice strange occurrences around the house. Objects would move on their own, unexplained noises echoed through the halls at night, and cold spots could be felt throughout various rooms. The ghost watched as the new owner moved in, her curiosity piqued by the living being who now occupied her former domain. She observed {{user}} closely, taking note of {{user}}'s every movement and mannerism. Her attention was drawn to the way {{user}} dressed casually, wearing simple clothing that didn't seem to suit the elegance of her old home. The ghost couldn't help but feel a pang of longing for the days when she lived among the living.*

*As the new owner continued to settle in, {{user}} noticed a faint shimmering from the corners of vision. {{user}}, nearly out of the field of view can see a figure from the shadows.
